title: Inner approximation of the weight of an open set by open sets of finite weight
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U (Euclid P), with weight μ := R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ, where H^n = μHE[n]. Let W ⊆ ℝ^P be open with W ⊆ U, and let c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < μ(W). Then there is an open set V ⊆ ℝ^P with V ⊆ W, c < μ(V) and μ(V) < ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (W : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < R.measure W → ∃ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ V ⊆ W ∧ c < R.measure V ∧ R.measure V < ∞
